transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in today because I just can’t seem to keep my mind on things the way I used to. I work as a credit counselor, and lately, I'll just stare at a loan worksheet or a client follow-up list and reread the same line over and over again. Then I end up putting off making my calls. It just feels like even simple decisions are a lot harder than they should be right now.
When did you first notice this change in your ability to concentrate?
Well, it's been going on for a while. I guess I first started noticing it... um, right after my close friend died. That was a little over two years ago now.
Since your friend died, have you been feeling sad or down most days?

Yes, I have. Most days, there’s just this... dull heaviness sitting with me. Even when I’m at the community center or out in my garden—places that really used to lift me up—I just feel like I’m going through the motions. I just kind of keep a smile pasted on, but inside, that heavy feeling is always there.
Since your friend died, have you often felt an intense longing for them or found yourself preoccupied with thoughts of them?

No, not really. I mean, I miss her, of course, but I'm not constantly thinking about her or longing for her like that. It's more just this general sadness that started then and never really went away.
Since this began, have you had a period of two months or longer when you felt generally free of the depressed mood?
No, I haven't. I mean, I might have a decent day here or there, but... no, definitely not two whole months. It's just been pretty constant since it started.
Have you been feeling low in energy or tired lately?

Yes, very much so. I wake up tired even after a full night's sleep. And by the time I’ve done a couple of client calls for work, or just watered the tomatoes in the garden, my body feels like I’ve put in a whole day already. I just don't have the energy I used to.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future?

Yeah, I suppose I do. I mean, I try to keep telling myself that things might turn around eventually. But... underneath it all, I just have this really tired feeling that this is how my life is going to be now. Like it's just going to stay smaller and harder, no matter what I try.
During this time, have you often felt bad about yourself or believed that you are not good enough?
No, I wouldn't say that. I don't really feel bad about myself, or like I'm a failure or anything. It's more just... I'm just so tired and down all the time. But I don't blame myself for it.
Since these symptoms began, have you noticed a significant change in your appetite or weight?

No, not really. My appetite is pretty much the same as it's always been. And I haven't noticed my clothes fitting any differently or anything, so my weight seems to be holding steady. I'm just eating normally.
Have you had any thoughts about dying or killing yourself?

No, I haven't. I mean, I know I've been feeling pretty low for a long time, but... no, I've never had any thoughts about wanting to die or hurting myself. It's just not something that crosses my mind.
